Do I need a reservation?

Reservations are recommended, particularly for dinner and weekends, and may be arranged online or by phone. We also reserve a portion of our seating for walk-in guests and will welcome you as soon as a table becomes available. If you are planning a special occasion, our team would be pleased to help you prepare in advance.

Can you accommodate dietary restrictions and allergies?

Yes. Our menus identify vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free selections, and the kitchen can adapt many dishes. Please share any allergies with your server when ordering so our team can guide you carefully and coordinate the appropriate kitchen precautions.

Do you take large groups or private events?

We would be delighted to host groups and private gatherings. For parties of eight or more, please contact the restaurant in advance so our team can arrange seating and, where available, a set menu or private space. Sharing the occasion and group size early will help us create a more seamless experience.

What are your opening hours?

Lunch is served from 11:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m., with dinner from 5:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m., Tuesday through Sunday. Hours may vary by location and during holidays, so we recommend confirming with your local WREN before visiting.
